scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p web/static/css web/static/js/vendor && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i web/assets/app.css -o web/static/css/app.css --minify && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js web/static/js/vendor/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/lucide/dist/umd/lucide.min.js web/static/js/vendor/lucide.min.js && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.js web/static/js/vendor/chart.umd.min.js
scripts.check:assets: tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i web/assets/app.css -o "$tmpdir/app.css" --minify && cmp "$tmpdir/app.css" web/static/css/app.css && cmp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js web/static/js/vendor/htmx.min.js && cmp node_modules/lucide/dist/umd/lucide.min.js web/static/js/vendor/lucide.min.js && cmp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.js web/static/js/vendor/chart.umd.min.js
